name: conexao-youtube
description: Plataforma colaborativa para curadoria e exportação voluntária de playlists do YouTube.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @conexao/api" "npm run dev -w @conexao/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @conexao/api && npm run build -w @conexao/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @conexao/api && npm run test -w @conexao/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @conexao/api && npm run lint -w @conexao/client
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w @conexao/client && npm run android:sync -w @conexao/client
